purpose: Reproducible science validation cases for Phase 2; no certification implied

cases.question: Can striding systematically erase spectral structure? Compare reported sketch stable rank with full diagonal oracle.
Does stride sampling omit a late nonfinite value? Separate observed counts from extrapolated fractions.
Should graph execution.sampled always be true, including exact topological metrics?
Validate directed reachability, path-length denominator, and weak versus strong components.
Validate path algorithm selection and behavior for negative cycles as well as finite negative edges.
Determine when sparsity, disconnectedness or low rank is expected domain structure rather than a quality defect.
